mapper.select: SELECT community_id, community_name, address, region_id, longitude, latitude, house_count, build_year, walk_speed, description, create_time, update_time FROM community ORDER BY community_id

SELECT community_id, community_name, address, region_id, longitude, latitude, house_count, build_year, walk_speed, description, create_time, update_time FROM community WHERE community_id = #{communityId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community(community_name, address, region_id, longitude, latitude, location, house_count, build_year, walk_speed, description) VALUES(#{communityName}, #{address}, #{regionId}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, geography::Point(#{latitude}, #{longitude}, 4326), #{houseCount}, #{buildYear}, #{walkSpeed}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE community SET community_name = #{communityName}, address = #{address}, region_id = #{regionId}, longitude = #{longitude}, latitude = #{latitude}, location = geography::Point(#{latitude}, #{longitude}, 4326), house_count = #{houseCount}, build_year = #{buildYear}, walk_speed = #{walkSpeed}, description = #{description}, update_time = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE community_id = #{communityId}
